title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from a raised angle. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left square (nearest the viewer, on the left). An orange disc marks the goal on the top-right square (far side, on the right). Up moves the token away from the viewer, Down toward, Left and Right sideways. Hint shows a yellow arrow over the token pointing along a move that brings it one step closer to the goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the orange goal square on the top-right.
game.hint: Each move changes either the row or the column by one. The shortest route is the rows between plus the columns between: 2 + 2 = 4 moves.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up means away from the starting camera view (toward the far row), Right means to the right. A move off the board does nothing and is not counted.
The start and goal are always the same; Reset returns the token to the same start. With no walls, the hint simply points toward the goal.
